facts.fact: Last known thylacine died at Hobart Zoo in Tasmania.

facts.label: Golden Toad Last Sighting
facts.fact: Brightly colored amphibian of Monteverde cloud forest last seen in 1989.

facts.label: West African Black Rhino Declared Extinct
facts.fact: IUCN declared the subspecies extinct after years without sightings.

facts.label: Pinta Island Tortoise Lonesome George Dies
facts.fact: Last known individual of the Pinta tortoise subspecies died in the Galapagos.

facts.label: Tootsie Roll Introduced
facts.fact: Leo Hirshfield created the chocolate-flavored chewy candy in New York.

facts.label: Hershey's Milk Chocolate Bar
facts.fact: Milton Hershey introduced the mass-produced milk chocolate bar in the U.S..

facts.label: Baby Ruth Candy Bar Introduced
facts.fact: Curtiss Candy Company introduced the peanut, caramel, and chocolate bar.

facts.label: Snickers Candy Bar Introduced
facts.fact: Mars introduced the nougat, caramel, and peanut chocolate bar.

facts.label: M&M's Introduced
facts.fact: Sugar-coated chocolate candies debuted for U.S. military rations.

facts.label: Jolly Rancher Founded
facts.fact: Brand originally launched in Golden, Colorado, as an ice cream and candy shop.

facts.label: Pez Candy Dispensers Marketed to Kids
facts.fact: Fruit-flavored compressed sugar candies paired with character dispensers.

facts.label: Reese's Peanut Butter Cups Name
facts.fact: H. B. Reese introduced the chocolate and peanut butter cup candy.

facts.label: Skittles Introduced in North America
facts.fact: Fruit-flavored chewy candies expanded to North America after UK debut.

facts.label: Great Pyramid of Giza Completed
facts.fact: Oldest of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World and the only one still standing.

facts.label: Temple of Artemis at Ephesus
facts.fact: Greek temple dedicated to Artemis, rebuilt multiple times in antiquity.

facts.label: Statue of Zeus at Olympia
facts.fact: Chryselephantine sculpture created by Phidias for the Temple of Zeus.

facts.label: Mausoleum at Halicarnassus
facts.fact: Tomb built for Mausolus, giving rise to the term "mausoleum".

facts.label: Colossus of Rhodes Completed
facts.fact: Giant bronze statue of the sun god Helios overlooking the harbor of Rhodes.

facts.label: Lighthouse of Alexandria Completed
facts.fact: Pharos lighthouse guided sailors into Alexandria's harbor for centuries.

facts.label: Great Wall of China Ming Completion
facts.fact: Major fortification expansions along China's northern border concluded under the Ming.

facts.label: Christ the Redeemer Unveiled
facts.fact: Art Deco statue overlooking Rio de Janeiro atop Corcovado mountain.

facts.label: New7Wonders of the World Announced
facts.fact: Global campaign named the modern list of seven wonders in 2007.

facts.label: Yuri Gagarin First Human Spaceflight
facts.fact: Orbited Earth aboard Vostok 1 as the first person in space.

facts.label: Valentina Tereshkova First Woman in Space
facts.fact: Flew aboard Vostok 6 and completed 48 orbits of Earth.

facts.label: Apollo 8 Lunar Orbit
facts.fact: First crewed spacecraft to leave low Earth orbit and orbit the Moon.

facts.label: Apollo 11 Moon Landing
facts.fact: First humans walked on the lunar surface in July 1969.

facts.label: Voyager 1 & 2 Launched
facts.fact: Twin probes launched to explore the outer planets and interstellar space.

facts.label: STS-1 Space Shuttle Columbia
facts.fact: First orbital flight of NASA's reusable Space Shuttle program.

facts.label: Mir Space Station Core Launched
facts.fact: Long-duration modular space station operated by the Soviet Union and Russia.

facts.label: ISS First Crew Expedition 1
facts.fact: First long-duration crew arrived aboard the International Space Station.

facts.label: Artemis I Uncrewed Lunar Flight
facts.fact: Test flight sending the Orion spacecraft around the Moon and back.

facts.label: Teddy Bear Popularized
facts.fact: Named after President Theodore Roosevelt following a hunting trip story.

facts.label: Lincoln Logs Introduced
facts.fact: Interlocking wooden toy logs designed by John Lloyd Wright.

facts.label: Slinky Invented
facts.fact: Helical metal spring toy invented by Richard James.

facts.label: LEGO Plastic Brick Patented
facts.fact: Modern interlocking stud-and-tube LEGO brick design introduced.

facts.label: Barbie Doll Debuts
facts.fact: Mattel introduced Barbie at the American International Toy Fair in New York.

facts.label: Hot Wheels Introduced
facts.fact: Mattel launched die-cast toy cars with low-friction axles and orange track.

facts.label: Rubik's Cube Invented
facts.fact: Ernő Rubik created the 3D combination puzzle in Budapest.

facts.label: Cabbage Patch Kids Craze
facts.fact: Soft-sculptured dolls became a major holiday shopping phenomenon.

facts.label: Beanie Babies Launched
facts.fact: Ty Warner introduced plush beanbag animals collected widely in the 1990s.
